title: Shanghai Now Also a City of Trees
titleZh: 上海，如今也是一座森林之城
displayName: Week 17 Thursday Shanghai Now Also a City of Trees

meta.intro: 在上海闵行的生态廊道，尽情“森”呼吸……

content.v: Sheep eating grass on a farm, birds singing in trees, and people taking leisurely walks along wooded walkways.
These were some unexpected sights I caught one morning near the
Wusong River
. For the past two weeks, I have been exploring the
upper reaches
of Suzhou Creek. The sheep farm lies behind
Jidong Village
. It’s part of an 11-kilometre-long
ecological corridor
in Minhang District.
I came across this corridor while researching China’s afforestation efforts.

It’s much higher than the city’s average of 19 percent. The corridor is like a green necklace. The forests and farmlands are its pearls. But words are not enough to express the joy I felt jogging through it. Unlike in the city’s central areas, here you find yourself walking among old and new trees.
At the west end of the corridor, I visited
Zhaojia Village
. There I met Mr. Zhao, an old farmer. “It’s beautiful, isn’t it?” he smiled at me. He told me that in the past, he could only walk a short distance in his crowded village.
“Many city travelers come here for exercise,” he added. “Before they go home, they often buy vegetables from our village. They are cheaper and fresher than those in many downtown supermarkets.”
By 2021, 32 kinds of birds had been discovered in the
bird sanctuary
at Jidong Village. The number had risen to 55 by 2022.
The corridor is becoming even more attractive as more trees are being planted. A team has been working on afforestation here for the past year.
“At peak times, we received more than ten truckloads of various trees every day,” the head of the team, Mr. Xu, told me.
A similar corridor is now taking shape on the northern bank of the Wusong River. Shanghai is no longer just a city of tall buildings. Increasingly, it has also become a city of trees.

sections.instruction: Fill in each blank in the article with a proper sentence given below. Each sentence can be used only once. Note that there are two more sentences than you will need.

content.v: I was surprised by its 80-percent forest cover.
They plant cherry blossoms and wisteria trees, among others.
You are IN the woodlands, not BY trees planted in sidewalks.
Now, he walks one or two hours every day along the corridor and feels great.
For Zhao, the corridor means both a healthy environment and more income for local farmers.
By connecting as many forests as possible, the corridor has also created a paradise for animals.
During the period of China’s 13th Five-Year Plan (2016-2020), the Chinese forest tourism industry grew greatly.
